Class AbstractResource

java.lang.Object
ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.AbstractResource
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractChildResource, RootResource
public abstract class AbstractResource extends Object
Base class for one URL node in the hand-rolled resource tree.

Key methods

  • getRelativePath() — the path segment this class owns (usually ends with /).
  • getDescendantByPath(String) — “who are my children?” for deeper paths.
  • httpGet() / httpPost() / … — what happens for that HTTP verb.
  • processRequest() — picks the verb method (called by the filter after routing).
  • requireSessionUser() / requireAdmin() — auth helpers used by protected endpoints.

getByPath algorithm (the important bit)

Given pathRelativeToResource like "v1/cart/":

  1. If the path does not start with this node’s getRelativePath(), return null (this branch is wrong).
  2. If the path equals this node’s segment exactly, return this (we are the leaf).
  3. Otherwise strip our segment and ask getDescendantByPath(String) to find a child.

Parents usually override getDescendantByPath with getDescendantFromChildren(String, java.util.List) or the UUID/long helpers.

    • getRelativePath

      public abstract String getRelativePath()
      Path segment owned by this node, relative to its parent. Examples: "" (root), "v1/", "products/".

    • getDescendantByPath

      protected abstract <T extends AbstractResource> T getDescendantByPath(String relativePath)
      Resolve a child for the remainder of the path after this node’s segment. Return null if nothing matches (caller will 404).

    • processRequest

      public final ServerResponse processRequest() throws IOException
      Dispatch to httpGet/httpPost/… based on the request method. Resources that do not override a verb inherit “405 Method Not Allowed”.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • getByPath

      public <T extends AbstractResource> T getByPath(String pathRelativeToResource)
      Walk from this node down the tree until a resource matches pathRelativeToResource.
      Parameters:
      pathRelativeToResource - full remaining path from this node’s perspective (at the root, that is the whole request path without a leading slash)
      Returns:
      the matching resource, or null if no branch fits

    • getNextSegment

      protected static String getNextSegment(String relativePath, boolean includeTrailingSlash)
      First path segment, optionally keeping the trailing slash. Example: "aaaaaaaa-…/" → "aaaaaaaa-…" or "aaaaaaaa-…/".

    • getDescendantFromChildren

      protected <T extends AbstractResource> T getDescendantFromChildren(String relativePath, List<Supplier<? extends AbstractResource>> children)
      Try each child supplier’s getByPath(String) until one returns non-null. This is how parents register route tables without a framework router.

    • getDescendantFromChildByUuid

      protected <T extends AbstractResource> T getDescendantFromChildByUuid(String relativePath, Function<UUID,? extends AbstractResource> childById)
      Match /…/{uuid}/… children. Invalid UUID text means “no match” (try another route).

    • getDescendantFromChildByLong

      protected <T extends AbstractResource> T getDescendantFromChildByLong(String relativePath, Function<Long,? extends AbstractResource> childById)
      Match /…/{longId}/… children (used for api_error_log ids).

    • requireSessionUser

      protected AppUserRow requireSessionUser()
      Require Authorization: session:{uuid} and load the user. Also refreshes session activity time.
      Throws:
      RequestFailedException - with HTTP 401 if missing/invalid/expired

    • requireAdmin

      protected AppUserRow requireAdmin()
